category_type.name: Free or lower cost health care

translations.name: GraceMed Health Clinic
translations.description: GraceMed offers medical, dental, and vision care in Wichita. Households at or below 200% of the federal poverty level can qualify for a sliding-fee discount; proof of income is required. You can still get care if you cannot afford to pay. Call 316-866-2000 for an appointment.
translations.website_description: Learn how to pay less for care at GraceMed.
